source.title: Jenson Button — Formula 1 Hall of Fame
source.author: Gerald Donaldson (verify page byline)
source.locator: See precise paragraph or heading locator on each linked claim; unlinked claims remain pending.
source.verification_note: Formula 1 Hall of Fame text inspected on 2026-10-24; unlinked claims still require direct corroboration; no human EN/UK review or independent publisher corroboration.

claims.en: Button took his first Formula 1 Grand Prix victory in Hungary in 2006.
claims.uk: Баттон здобув свою першу перемогу на Гран-прі Формули-1 в Угорщині у 2006 році.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'His reputation as a winless wonder ended': 2006 Hungarian Grand Prix.

claims.en: Button won the 2009 Formula 1 Drivers' World Championship driving for Brawn GP.
claims.uk: Баттон став чемпіоном світу Формули-1 серед пілотів у 2009 році за Brawn GP.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Nonetheless, Jenson steadily accumulated': 2009 title for Brawn GP.

claims.en: Button won six of the first seven races of the 2009 season.
claims.uk: Баттон виграв шість із перших семи перегонів сезону 2009 року.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Against all the odds and expectations': six of first seven 2009 wins.

claims.en: Button joined McLaren for the 2010 Formula 1 season.
claims.uk: Баттон приєднався до McLaren у сезоні Формули-1 2010 року.

gaps: Record precise per-claim source locators and independent corroboration.
Human review of both languages and exact revision required before publication.
